scope: All six public OEQ/MCQ, full/lite/TU metadata files. Exact mode, study, insight, question number, formulation and input-description matches are aliases; changed formulations or declared inputs retain separate records. These 130 records share 52 insight groups across 13 studies and do not represent independent workflows.
grading_adaptation: Open-answer source grading uses an LLM judge; MCQ uses exact option sets. Training tasks must instead produce verifiable quantitative artifacts on independent biological observations.
